tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la spring ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dge tshogs dpag med rin chen las bsgrubs shing*// zag pa med dbyings rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khrungs// phrin las rnam bzhi'i bang rim yongs rdzogs pa// rgyal ba lhun po'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal// ye shes dbang po'i klu dbang gis sprul zhing*// shes bya'i mkha' kun rnam par khyab gyur la// rnam grol lo tog kun nas rgyas byed pa'i// dam chos rnam par sgrogs pa'i char sprin rgyal// lhag bsam sa bon snying rje'i chu yis bskrun// yon tan lo 'dab rtogs pa'i snying po can// sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gsung zer gyis phye ba'i// dge 'dun chu skyes tshal rab rgyas gyur cig /gang gi lhag bsam nam mkha'i dbyings ltar dri med cing*// de yi blo gros nyin mor byed ltar rab gsal la// mdzad spyod dge ba zla ba tshes pa ltar mdzes pa'i// mi yi dbang po dbang phyug dam pa rnam par rgyal// gang gi dad bzang dri med chu 'dzin rnam par rol pa rnam dpyod glog gi phreng ba can// 'dun pa'i rlung shugs rab tu g.yo bas bskyod pa las byung spring yig tshig gi char rgyun gang*// bshes gnyen dam pa'i klu dbang dang bcas tshogs kyi mchog rab 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho rab yangs par// bstan pa'i chu gter rnam par 'phel bas skye dgu'i nyer 'tshor nye bar gnas phyir dbab par bgyi// rigs dang cho 'brang rnam par dag cing*/ dpal dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs la/ dad pa dang brtse ba rmad du byung bas/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan par mdzad pa can/ rgyal po chen po'i pho brang nas/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'phags pas/ byang chub snying po rdo rje'i gdan nas/ byang phyogs su bgrod pa'i gnas/ gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba/ bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyis thub pa'i bstan pa 'phel bar lung bstan zhing*/

legs par sbyangs pa'i skyes bu dam pa 'byung ba'i gnas/ dbus dang gtsang gi sa'i cha na bzhugs pa/ legs par sbyangs pa'i thugs/ yid bzhin gyi mtsho ltar zab cing yangs la rnyog pa dang bral ba/ mang du gsan pa'i chab kyis rnam par bltams shing*/ yon tan rin po che'i gter du ma 'dzin pa/ brtse ba chen po'i rlung gi shugs kyis/ rnam par dpyod pa'i chu 'dzin spobs pa'i glog gi 'od 'gyu ba nye bar phyung nas legs par bshad pa'i char gyi rgyun rnam par phab pas/ slob grwa'i skye bo'i yid kyi zhing sar rtogs pa dge ba'i lo tog rnam par bskrun par mdzad pa'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ de nyid dang tshul mtshungs pa'i zhar chos pa rnams dang*/ de dag gi rjes su 'jug cing*/ tshul khrims kyi lus yon tan gyi rgyan gyis spras shing*/ dam pa rnams kyi bgrod pa'i lam la nye bar zhugs pa/ 'dus pa rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams kyi snyan du gsol pa/ 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho bshes gnyen lhun por bcas// bstan pa rin chen sgron ma'i rten gyur khyod// zo bdog bde'am sku nyams dang ldan nam// ldang ba yang ngam gsol zas legs 'phrod dam// dgyes dgur spyod dam ji ltar dgongs pa'i don// chos bzhin grub bam klog dang kha ton dang*// bzlas brjod bsam gtan rnam par 'phel lam zhes// bsam pa dge bas ring nas 'dri zhing mchis// skabs kyi don la bdag cag gi bla ma chos kyi rje tshad med pa'i mkhyen rab dang*/ thugs rjer ldan pa des/ nyid kyi don dang bde ba la ma gzigs par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang*/ sems can spyi la phan par dgongs nas/ rgyal rgyud kyi drung du byon/ ji ltar phan pa dang don du 'gyur ba mdzad pa de thams cad kyi thugs la gsal/ de'i rjes su nged kyis kyang ji ltar nus pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i zhabs tog dang*/ sems can la gang phan bgyis pa lags/ bye brag tu rgyal po chen po 'di'i thugs dgongs la/

drang po'i chos kyis rgyal khams thams cad legs par bskyang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'ang rgyas par byed pa'i dgongs pa bzang po gda'/ khong gi drung du nged bsdad nas kyang rang gi don gtso bor ma bsgrubs par khong gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gnas lugs kyi babs thugs su chud pa dang*/ blang ba dang dor ba'i dmigs phyed pa/ chos dang chos ltar bcos pa'i rnam dbye mkhas par byas nas/ sngon gyi chos rgyal kun dang rjes su mthun par bstan pa'i bdag po mdzad pa'i rkyen byas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi la gang phan pa dang*/ mi sde spyi la gang phan gyi zhu ba yang yang byas nas/ lung dang las ka bzang po zhus nas bskur ba thams cad kyi thugs la gsal te mchi/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshul khrims dag pa dang*/ chos kyi bshad nyan lags pas de la phan pa'i zhu ba sngar mang du byas/ da res chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i yo byad dang gser yig pa btang ba lags pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ dge 'dun rnams kyis/ rgyal po chen po sku tshe ring zhing thugs dgongs chos dang mthun par 'grub pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par bya ba dang*/ sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par bya ba'i don du/ chos bshad nyan dang*/ sgom sgrub dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kha ton dang*/ dge sbyor gyi rim pa rnams dang*/ chos kyi gtam gyis dus 'da' bar byas nas/ thugs mthun pa'i sgo nas smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab par zhu/ chos 'khor zin nas kyang dus thams cad du bshad nyan la brtson par mdzad par zhu/ khyed dge 'dun thams cad chos nyan bshad dang chos kyi bya ba legs par mdzad pa'i bdag gnyer nged kyi nus tshad kyis byed par lags/ stong gsum 'jig rten khams 'di gser dag gis// bkang nas gang la sbyin pa byin pa bas// gang gis tshig bzhi'i tshigs bcad gcig brjod pa// de yi bsod nams de 'dra de la med// de skad lung las 'byung zhing rigs pas kyang*// nges par grub pa yin te gang gi phyir// ma lus 'gro ba'i srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun// dge ba spyad pa las 'byung de yang ni// bde bar gshegs pa'i chos tshul la brten zhing*// chos de'ang thos pa nyid la rag las phyir// de ltar lung dang rigs pas don ched du// grub pa'i don la 'bad pa tshul lags pas// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab dri med dang*// dgongs pa nges par 'grel ba'i bstan bcos mchog

/'byung khungs bzang po'i gling las byung gyur zhing*// mkhas pa'i ded dpon mchog las legs 'ongs la// blo gsal rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa// srid pa'i rims nad sel ba'i nor bu mchog /tshul khrims dag pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bzhag nas// thos dang bsam pa'i byi dor legs byas te// tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i rim gros legs mchod nas// snyan pa'i 'od kyis sa gsum rab gsal zhing*// srid zhi'i rgud pa ma lus kun bsal te// 'byor pa gnyis kyi dpal 'byor rgya mtsho yis// bdag gzhan thams cad kun nas rab 'byor zhing*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal yang thob par mdzod// gang zhig thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i tshe// chos la brtson bgyid ngo mtshar ci zhig mchis// snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba rnams la chos// gsal bar bgyid pa shin tu ngo mtshar lags// bdag gis de ltar brjod pa gang lags pa// de kun mkhyen bzang khyed kyi thugs la gsal// de lta mod kyi mi yi dbang po yis// 'phrin gyis gdams par gyis zhes bskul ba dang*// zla ba'i zer gyis kun+da'i phreng ba ltar// dge ba'i 'dun pa kun nas rgyas phyir dang*// dad pas glengs pa don med mi 'gyur slad// bdag gi de skad glengs pa'ang de ltar dgongs// de ltar mi yi dbang po dad pa'i yid// gang gis legs bshad ngag gis rab bskul nas// 'gro ba'i don du bstan pa gnas pa'i phyir// rin chen chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor bas// rab 'byam phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs gyur pa'i// rgyal ba chos kyi dbang phyug thams cad kyis// theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor nas// 'gro kun kun mkhyen nyid du 'gyur bar shog /gnas skabs su yang sbyin bdag rgyal po yi// sku tshe ring zhing dbang phyug phun sum tshogs// bar du gcod pa thams cad nyer zhi zhing*// thugs kyi dgongs pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog /'gro ba kun kyang nad dang mu ge dang*// kun tu 'khrug pa thams cad nyer zhi nas// chos dang zang zing longs spyod dri med la// dus rnams kun tu dga' mgur spyod par shog
/khyi lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la/ pho brang chen mor bris pa'i yi ge phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
